Iran, UAE Discuss Regional Peace at Delhi Meeting

Iran and the United Arab Emirates held a meeting in Delhi, expressing hope for de-escalation and regional peace. Both nations backed a joint BRICS statement that urged restraint amid ongoing conflicts. The discussions focused on turning a new page in their relations and fostering a more peaceful regional environment.
